Strategy: Reward absolute leftovers between forty-five and sixty-five, and penalize leftovers between fifteen and thirty, shifting the preferred band higher than the earlier twenty-to-thirty-five version. It may help if larger leftovers stay useful longer, but may fail by chasing bins too loose to matter.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (20 if r - item >= 45 and r - item <= 65 else 0) - (20 if r - item >= 15 and r - item <= 30 else 0) for r in bins]
```
